snippet.title: OAR'SOME ADVENTURES - Official Game Trailer
snippet.description:
Our official FREE DEMO is out now! Check it out here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4555210/Oarsome_Adventures/
Paddles up, Hosers! OAR'SOME Adventures is a cozy/chaotic rafting and nature adventure for 1-8 players. Casually paddle your way down the river alone, or gather your friends for whitewater mischief and exploration in beautiful, yet dangerous, surroundings.

WISHLIST ON STEAM TOO!! https://store.steampowered.com/app/4555210/Oarsome_Adventures/
